mdp.carriers.size: {kind} · {length} × {width} cm, loaded to {height} cm · carries up to {kg} kg
mdp.carriers.holds: {holds, plural, one {Holds about # parcel of size M} other {Holds about # parcels of size M}}: {bags, plural, =0 {less than a full bag} one {# full bag} other {# full bags}}.
mdp.carriers.full: You keep {n} kinds, the most there is room for: change or take one off to add another.
mdp.carriers.ownerDecides: The hub’s owner says what it moves bags on.
mdp.carriers.sheetBody: Measure the space a load may take on it — for a pallet, how high you stack it — and say what it may carry. How many parcels it holds is worked out from those.
mdp.carriers.nameLabel: Its name, as your people call it
mdp.carriers.err.name: Give it a name, as your people call it.
mdp.carriers.err.cm: Say each size in whole centimetres, from 20 to 300.
mdp.carriers.err.kg: Say what it may carry in whole kilograms, from 10 to 3,000.
mdp.carriers.err.empty: Say what it weighs empty in whole kilograms, from 1 to 500 — or leave it out.
mdp.moves.title: Carriers between hubs
mdp.moves.lede: Carriers that go with a driver to another hub, and how they come back.
mdp.moves.way.with_driver: They go back with the driver who brings them.
mdp.moves.way.left: They are left with you: yours to keep or use.
mdp.moves.way.return_job: Keep them aside: their hub posts a return job for them.
mdp.moves.wayShort.return_job: Kept there for a return job.
mdp.moves.do.with_driver: Counted back out to the driver
mdp.moves.do.return_job: Kept aside for their return job
mdp.moves.keptJob: Kept aside for {hub}: their return job is {code}.
mdp.moves.state.with_driver: Back with {driver}: {n} of {count} counted out at {hub}.
mdp.moves.state.kept: Kept at {hub} for their return job.
mdp.moves.ownerPosts: The hub’s owner posts their return job.
mdp.moves.noKinds: Add your pallets, cages or crates above first.
mdp.moves.sent: Sent. The other hub is told what to do with them.
mdp.moves.posted: Return job {code} posted: on the board for any driver.
mdp.moves.sendBody: Say which, how many and where they go, and how they come back — then scan the pass of the driver who takes them.
mdp.moves.wayOpt.with_driver: With the driver, on the same visit
mdp.moves.wayOpt.left: Left there: given up, the other hub’s to keep or use
mdp.moves.wayOpt.return_job: Kept there for a return job you post and pay
mdp.moves.countOutBody: How many went back with {driver}? Never more than the {count} that came.
mdp.moves.jobBody: A load from {hub} back to you, on the board for any driver and priced as any load. You pay the carrier, between the two of you.
mdp.moves.weightLabel: What they weigh together, in kg
mdp.moves.err.to: Say which hub they go to.
mdp.moves.err.pass: Scan the pass of the driver who takes them.
mdp.moves.err.countOut: Count what went back: from none to the {count} that came.
mdp.moves.err.weight: Say what they weigh together, in whole kilograms.
mdp.bulk.stopBody: Stores can no longer book with you. What they booked already still comes: take it in as before.
mdp.bulk.saved: Saved: stores see it when they ship
mdp.bulk.errNoDay: Choose at least one day you receive — or do without set hours.
mdp.bulk.errCloses: On a day you receive, closing comes after opening.
mdp.bulk.errDoors: Count the doors from 1 to 50, or leave it blank.
mdp.bulk.feesTitle: What you charge to take in each unit (optional)
mdp.bulk.feesHint: Stores pay it when they book, for each unit, and you are paid it for each one you count in at your door. Leave a kind blank to take it in for nothing.
mdp.bulk.fees: You charge {fees} to take them in.
mdp.bulk.noFees: You charge nothing to take them in.
mdp.bulk.errFee: Write each fee as a sum of money, like 150 or 12.50, or leave it blank.
mdp.arrival.doorBody: Count what came before you scan anything.
mdp.arrival.fewer: Fewer than booked: scan what came. What is not there stays the store’s.
mdp.arrival.more: More than booked: scan what is on them. A parcel not on this arrival is refused — set it aside.
mdp.arrival.moreFee: More than booked: the store pays for the others now, at your fee. Where it cannot, take in only what it booked.
mdp.arrival.fee: Your receiving fee: {each}, paid to you for each one you count in.
mdp.arrival.feePaid: Paid to you for receiving: {amount}, for {units}.
mdp.arrival.emptiesBody: Once they are unloaded, count the store’s pallets, cages or sacks out at your door, to whoever brought them. Nothing more is kept of them.
mdp.arrival.emptiesDone: {units} went back with whoever brought them, counted out by {who}.
mdp.arrival.notePlaceholder: A pallet’s wrap torn, a carton crushed…
mdp.arrival.missedBody: Its day is over and nothing came. Say so: the store is told, and books its parcels again.
mdp.arrival.lastDest: Goes to {dest}. Put it with the parcels to sort.
mdp.arrival.toScan: {n, plural, one {# still to scan} other {# still to scan}}
mdp.arrival.tamper: One of them cut or opened? Scan it in, then report it
mdp.arrival.finish: Done: the rest did not come
mdp.arrival.finishBody: {n, plural, one {# parcel booked on it was not scanned in. It stays the store’s, and the store is told.} other {# parcels booked on it were not scanned in. They stay the store’s, and the store is told.}}
mdp.arrival.someMissing: {done} of {all} scanned in. Not there, still the store’s: {ids}
mdp.arrival.withdrawnLine: The store withdrew it: it is not coming.
mdp.arrival.missedLine: Said not to have come. The store books its parcels again.
mdp.arrival.gone: This arrival is no longer on the list.
mdp.toast.arrivalAllIn: {n, plural, one {The parcel is in} other {All # parcels in}}
mdp.toast.arrivalAllInDetail: They wait with the parcels to sort.
mdp.toast.arrivalFinished: {all, plural, one {{done} of # parcel in} other {{done} of # parcels in}}
mdp.toast.arrivalFinishedMissing: The store is told what was not there.
mdp.toast.arrivalMissedDetail: The store is told, and books its parcels again.
